name: Item availability code
description: Code specifying the availability of an item.

values.name: New, announcement only
values.description: New, announcement only The item is announced only, not yet available.

values.name: New, available
values.description: New, available The item is new and available.

values.name: Prototype
values.description: Prototype The item is a prototype and is not yet in normal production.

values.name: Special
values.description: Special Item is not a standard product.

values.name: Temporarily out
values.description: Temporarily out Item is temporarily not available.

values.name: Manufacture out
values.description: Manufacture out Item is out of production.

values.name: Discontinued
values.description: Discontinued Item is no longer available because it is discontinued.

values.name: Seasonally available only
values.description: Seasonally available only Item is only seasonally available.

values.name: Deletion, announcement only
values.description: Deletion, announcement only The announcement of a deletion.
